key_findings.finding: Developed a simple method for scaling up the constrained formation of fibrous nanostructures (CoFFiN) process to fabricate relatively large foams.
Successfully tested a simple method for selective leaching of Pd catalyst material trapped in the foam during growth.
The growth of a quality single piece of fiber foam was not possible simply by injecting the gas mixture into the mold.
A growth mold 20 times larger, by volume, than any previously employed successfully made a high-quality single CNFF.
The foams were virtually identical to the smaller CNFF described in earlier work and far more mechanically robust than commercially available cellular carbon foams.
